SLOs/targets: p95 latency <150ms for 128-token chat flows (low-latency trade alerts), p99 <400ms; throughput planning target: 200 concurrent chat sessions or ~180 reqs/s at 512-token average for embeddings/reranks.

Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to quantized model (lower-cost) if latency/queue exceeds SLO; Redwood's proposal includes model variant routing and cache warmers — client supportive.

Insurance ask: request for Redwood to add client as additional insured on cyber policy or provide standalone certificate with $5M+ cyber liability. Procurement wants this before signing reserved capacity commitment.

Commercial ask: 12–24 month reserved contract, annual true-up, ability to increase GPUs w/30d notice. Wants transparent per-token economics at reserved vs burst rates.
